plugins.name: nightpub-ui
plugins.description: NightPub's dark look for Claude Code with a live usage panel: three palettes, two animated backgrounds, and a pane for context, cost, rate limits and activity, plus a live band above the prompt while Claude works. Everything is chosen on the pane's settings page.
